source_title: Indiana DOR Motor Carrier Services — Oversize/Overweight (OSOW); Form M-204 General Provisions; ISP Superload Escorts

superload_thresholds.note: Indiana superload (ISP 'Superload Escorts') = any vehicle+load over 17' wide, 15' high, 110' long, or 108,000 lbs; Indiana State Police escort obtained via CVED (812-533-1100), arranged within 72 hrs. A $10 executive fee applies over 120,000 lbs. Loads over 16' wide, over 15' high, or over 200,000 lbs are restricted to Mon-Fri 8:30 a.m.-3:30 p.m.

width.note: over 12'4": 1 escort — front on undivided highways, rear on divided highways (Form M-204)
14'4"-17' wide: 1 rear escort on dual-lane divided highway; 2 escorts (front + rear) on all other roads
over 17' wide is superload — Indiana State Police escort arranged via CVED

height.note: over 14'6": escort with height stick traveling in front (Form M-204)
over 15' high is superload — ISP escort via CVED plus height pole

length.note: over 110' is superload — 1 escort (front on undivided, rear on divided) plus ISP escort arranged via CVED

single_trip.fee_formula: Oversize single-trip: $20 (<=95' L, <=13'6" H, <=12'4" W); $30 (96'-110' L, 12'5"-16' W or 13'7"-15' H); $40 (16' W / 15' H / 80,000 lbs). Overweight single-trip = $20 base + per-mile by gross weight: $0.35/mi <=108,000 lbs; $0.60/mi 108,001-150,000; $1.00/mi >150,000. Oversize+overweight = greater of the two calculated fees. +$10 executive fee over 120,000 lbs. (Indiana DOR OSOW Vehicle Permit Fees.)
single_trip.note: Divisible-load single-trip (7 days) = $20 + $0.25/ESAL-mile. Overweight commodity permits allow up to 120,000 lbs (bulk milk up to 154,000 lbs).

annual.note: Oversize 90-day $100; oversize annual $405; ocean sealed container annual $800; special weight registration $25; various mobile-home rig permits $10-$2,000.

movement_restrictions: <=110' L, <=10' W, <=13'6" H, <200,000 lbs: continuous travel 7 days/week
>110' L, 10'-14'4" W, <=15' H: 7 days/week, one-half hour before sunrise to one-half hour after sunset
>16' W, or >15' H, or >200,000 lbs: Mon-Fri 8:30 a.m.-3:30 p.m. only
No holiday travel (New Year's, Memorial, Independence, Labor, Thanksgiving, Christmas) from noon the last weekday before; overweight-commodity and bulk-milk permits exempt
No operation when visibility <500 ft or wind >25 mph
Speed max 55 mph when over 85' long, over 10'6" wide, or above legal height
Not valid on I-65/I-70 inside I-465, closed/posted roads, or county roads/city streets
notes: Legal width 8'6", height 13'6", 40' single vehicle / 53' loaded semi, gross 80,000 lbs subject to Federal Bridge axle weights.

Escort matrix (Form M-204), superload thresholds (ISP), and fees (DOR OSOW fee schedule) all sourced from official Indiana documents. M-204 has an internal inconsistency (escort trigger stated as 14'6" height but width band written 14'4"-17') — reported per the fee/manual values.
State-level rules only — county/city permits, bridge-specific engineering and low-clearance routing are out of scope.
